In the linear gain-one formation model on Z^(d+1) (d = 2 and 3) pin one record at the origin to theta = 1 and propagate the MEAN: theta(x) = average of the d+1 predecessors. (1) Show the response at x = (a_0, ..., a_d) >= 0 is the multinomial probability (sum a)!/(prod a_i!) (d+1)^-(sum a); verify by direct propagation on a box. (2) Asymptotics: along the axis (1,..,1) the response decays like n^(-d/2) (n the level), with Gaussian width ~ sqrt n across it: give the exact constants for d = 2, 3. (3) Compare with the COVARIANCE of block 35: sigma^2 phi^s/(1-u) at equal level is a Green function of the d-dimensional plane (log in d = 2, 1/r in d = 3). State precisely how the two differ (support: forward cone against the whole plane; decay law; symmetry) and check numerically that no constant makes response = constant x covariance (the equilibrium fluctuation-response relation fails). Expectation: it fails.
